disclosure: Fixed connectome model + trained linear decoder. Approximate retinal mapping. Closed numeric alphabet. Fly motion is a presentation effect. Binned activity, not exact spike timestamps.

retinal_atlas.description: Lamina-column atlas inferred from strongest R1-R6 to L1/L2/L3 contacts and assignedOlHex annotations. Eye outlines and hexagonal facets are schematic. Colors show recorded sampled brightness, not retinal spikes or measured optical fields.
